تستنطقن (form X)

# تُسْتَنْطَقْنَ (tustanṭaqna) /tus.tan.tˤaq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
